title: dioscorea convolvulacea var. glabra
intro: Dioscorea convolvulacea var. glabra, commonly known as smooth yam, is a species of yam native to Mexico and Central America. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, as well as its potential to regulate blood sugar levels. Dioscorea convolvulacea var. glabra is also known for its therapeutic actions, including cardiotonic, diuretic, and anti-hypertensive effects, which contribute to its traditional use in treating various cardiovascular diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include diosgenin, a saponin with estrogenic and anti-inflammatory properties, as well as other compounds that contribute to its therapeutic potential.
